diagnosis.summary: The IR specifies an unconditional Switch.Off action after the 15-minute delay. The candidate incorrectly wraps this action in an if statement that re-checks the temperature condition. Since the temperature input became null at the end of the delay, the guard failed, preventing the action from executing.
diagnosis.change_summary: Removed the conditional if block around switch_off() to make it an unconditional call as specified in the IR.
